column1: # Player-facing settings: the iOS launcher (dm/ios/Sources/Launcher.swift) shows them before the game starts. dm/games/settings.py writes one game's list into its app (dm/launcher.json,
# build_ipa.sh): the rows whose condition holds for that game, with its defaults. Each sets an environment variable the host reads when the game starts; one an env file sets
# (Documents/env.txt, the bundle's dm/env.txt) is shown but kept. Diagnostic switches stay environment-only, so they are not listed here. Columns, separated by tabs:
#   variable  the environment variable the setting sets
#   kind      choice: values value=label,... (languages: the game's own, from its control data); range: values low:high:step, shown as a percentage; toggle: 1 / 0, values -
#   default   a value; DM_GAME_<NAME>: the host's own default from the game profile (game_profile.h, game.py); build:<VAR>: the IPA build's setting (build_ipa.sh)
#   shown     always; DM_GAME_<NAME>!=<value> or ==<value>; fixups:<KEY>: main's rewriter table has that key (a stub in the game's build, patch_nso.py); languages>1; several joined by & must all hold
#   label, note  the setting's name and the line under it (the note may be empty)
